explanation: Search from both candidate nodes toward the middle, stopping if either candidate reaches the other. If one reaches the middle properly, search downward from the middle for the opposite candidate. These searches follow BST value comparisons and compare node identity.
timeComplexity: O(h) time for tree height h.
